```{{python}}
# | echo: false
# | output: false
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from pdstools.explanations import Explanations
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
import plotly.io as pio

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
# Plotly serializes figures at display time, so generated pages set the
# renderer before any plots are shown. The pre-render script substitutes this
# placeholder with notebook for fully embedded reports or notebook_connected
# for CDN-backed reports.
pio.renderers.default = "{PLOTLY_RENDERER}"

try:
    explanations = Explanations.from_aggregates(
        data_folder="{DATA_FOLDER}",
    )
    explanations.aggregate.data_pattern = "{DATA_PATTERN}"
except Exception as e:
    logger.error(f"Failed to initialize Explanations: {{e}}")
    raise
```
